subject: Television & Streaming
title: MeToo and the Reckoning in Television
description: A quick win: understand MeToo and the Reckoning in Television.

hook.text: In 2017, allegations against Harvey Weinstein triggered a wave of revelations about abuse across the entertainment.

buildup.text: Television was deeply affected. Powerful showrunners, executives, and stars were accused of harassment and assault.

discovery.text: Les Moonves, CBS's CEO, was forced out. Shows were canceled.

twist.text: Television had spent decades telling stories about justice while its own workplaces were rife with injustice.

climax.text: The MeToo movement forced the TV industry to confront the gap between the values it broadcast and the reality behind.

punchline.text: The industry that told stories of justice had to face its own.

quiz.question: What did the MeToo movement reveal about the television industry?
options: It was the most equitable industry
Powerful figures had perpetuated harassment despite the industry's progressive storytelling
